description: Check CPU, GPU, memory, disk, network and battery on any of your bb machines from one sidebar panel. Pick the bb server, your own machines or BB Box boxes from a searchable list, and each opens with live charts and its five busiest processes. On Apple silicon Macs it adds CPU and GPU temperature and power, read by a small bundled helper that needs no root. Tailscale name, address and tags sit at the bottom, each with a copy button. Works on Linux, macOS and WSL, and optional in-app alerts warn when the bb server stays overloaded.
